reason: Candidate A more directly addresses why equimolar CoCrFeNiTi remains relatively soft yet ductile by linking minimal lattice distortion to reduced dislocation pinning, and proposes a clear composition-based experiment to test that mechanism. Candidate B’s focus on processing routes (HEBM + SPS) is interesting but less directly tied to explaining the initial low-hardness, high-ductility state of the cast alloy.
